title: New Update
message:
• Redesigned the Local Music screen with a cleaner layout, smooth animations, a blue highlight for the active filter (All Tracks, Artists A-Z, Recent), bouncier scrolling, and live search and track counts.
• Made playback start immediately when you tap a song so there is no delay before the music begins, while keeping your full queue ready smoothly in the background.
• Improved overall app stability and upgraded the Stats screen so album covers load reliably, text displays cleanly, and everything updates smoothly.
